artist_notes.name: Rick Wilhite
artist_notes.note: Detroit house elder, Three Chairs member and longtime owner of the Vibes New & Used record shop; soulful, deep, crate-digger sets in the Moodymann/Theo Parrish circle.

artist_notes.name: SEEPS
artist_notes.note: Bronx-born, LA-based DJ steeped in NYC's '90s golden-era house and disco/boogie.

artist_notes.name: bilaliwood
artist_notes.note: NYC/LA DJ, ex-child actor, left-of-center selections across genres.

curator_note: Rick Wilhite doesn't make it west often, and he plays the way the Detroit old guard does, long and soulful. Venue is still TBA, but with SEEPS on the bill it should be a proper late one.
description: Late-night Dialed In party with Detroit's Rick Wilhite, SEEPS and bilaliwood; location TBA.

artist_notes.name: Sky Rivers
artist_notes.note: LA-native DJ since the acid-house '90s, cut his teeth in SF's scene in the 2000s; deep vinyl collector.

curator_note: Midnight to 8am at a secret location is the draw here, not the names. Sky Rivers brings real local depth if you want a proper dawn-patrol night.
description: Melt Collective's all-night house and techno party, 11:59pm to 8am, location TBA.

curator_note: A recurring tech-house night in a big Hollywood room with no lineup announced. Free with early RSVP makes it a low-risk Black Friday weekend option, nothing more.
description: Space Yacht's Tech My House night at Academy LA; free with RSVP before 11pm.

curator_note: Blind Tiger's regular DTLA after-hours, running until 5am with a minimal and tech-house bent. Lineup is unannounced, so go for the room and the hour. RSVP early to skip the cover.
description: Blind Tiger's recurring after-hours at The Lexington, 11pm to 5am.

curator_note: This is a reggaeton, dembow and baile funk party from the queer Latinx collective Queerokela, not a techno night despite the baseline tag. It's fun, but it's well outside the house and techno core.
description: Queerokela party at The Melrose House with a reggaeton, dembow, baile funk and perreo lineup.

curator_note: A free record-release night at a DTLA bar, mixing downtempo and deep house. Low-key and walkable from home. I couldn't verify the artists, so treat it as a taste test.
description: Free Frenz Part 1 record-release party at Library Bar with Gil Tamazyan and friends.

curator_note: The Hustle is a twice-monthly disco night at Gold Diggers, an easy neighborhood option. The room and the groove are the draw. It's a recurring party, so don't expect a special booking.
description: First and third Saturday disco party at Gold Diggers in East Hollywood.

artist_notes.name: James Axon
artist_notes.note: LA DJ, dublab resident and founder of the queer underground party Planet Love; deep house, dreamy techno, Italo and Balearic.

curator_note: James Axon's own Planet Love, with a deep house, UK garage and techno mix and a real musician's ear on selection. It's a queer-oriented party with the location TBA, so know that going in.
description: Planet Love, James Axon's queer underground party, with livwutang and Mez Monty; 11pm to 6am, location TBA.

curator_note: Saturday night of Blind Tiger's Lexington after-hours, which is the same format as Friday. Lineup is a mystery, so it's a bet on the room. The free RSVP window closes early.
description: Blind Tiger's recurring after-hours at The Lexington, 11pm to 5am.
